findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood contact surfaces are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. The bottom of the dish drying rack. 
2. The bottom of the drink cooler in the storage room.

This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The top of the inside of the ice machine is observed to have slight soil residue accumulation on it. CORRECTED- The PIC cleaned this during the inspection and was educated on the importance of maintaining it clean. Ensure that food contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3-305.11: There were cases of drinks being stored on the floor in the dry storage area. Ensure that all food is stored at least 6 inches above the floor to protect them from contamination. 

(A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor.
